input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: new research-algorithm tool ventures/roc-analysis (ROC/AUC, DeLong paired test, cut-offs, partial AUC, decision curves)

doc_friction.issue: Very useful: it listed every out-of-folder registration and the CSV formula-guard fix in one pass. Its --check exits 2 with 'registrations complete', which reads as a usage error.

The 'skip audits already clean' list is long, and none of it applies to a build-a-tool run. A one-line pointer to portfolio/research-tools/README.md as the usual explore output would have saved some orientation time.

notes: Idea: ROC analysis as a research-algorithm tool. 0 of 1,412 venture READMEs mentioned DeLong, Youden or decision curves; probability-calibration reports only a bare AUC. Engine verified against scipy 1.18.1 Mann-Whitney and a direct O(mn) DeLong computation (numpy 2.5.3) on 3 cases (AUC 1e-12, covariance 1e-14, chi-square 1e-7). Hanley & McNeil 1982 rating data give AUC 0.8932 against the published 0.893. Example: UCI WDBC (CC BY 4.0). Worst perimeter and worst concave points cannot be told apart (paired p = 0.24); a cross-validated combined model beats both (p <= 0.0001). Local checks: node --test on 4 roc-analysis test files plus probability-calibration's page.test, 32+ passing; headless Chromium load with 0 console errors and no horizontal scroll at 390 px; register-tool --check clean; check_posts clean; venture-preflight run (result in PR). No separate agent doc: the README's Verification and Limits sections cover what a later run needs.
